learning_objective: 🎯 Understand relational databases, primary/foreign keys, create tables in LibreOffice Base, and manipulate data using Forms, Queries (SQL), and Reports!

क्वेरी (डेटाबेस से जानकारी खोजने का निर्देश)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A Relational Database Management System (like LibreOffice Base, MySQL, Oracle) stores data in structured Tables (rows/records and columns/fields) that can be linked to each other.
A Primary Key uniquely identifies each record in a table (e.g., Roll_Number)—it cannot be null or duplicate. A Foreign Key is a field in one table that links to the primary key of another table.
Queries retrieve specific data based on conditions. SQL (Structured Query Language) uses commands like `SELECT * FROM Students WHERE Marks > 80;` to filter information.
A Form provides a user-friendly graphical interface for entering and editing data. A Report presents database results in a formal, printable summary format.

fun_activity.title: 🔑 Pick the Primary Key
fun_activity.instructions: Look at a student ID card: it shows Name, Class, Blood Group, and Admission Number. Which of these four fields makes a perfect Primary Key and why? (Hint: Can two students have the same name?)

exam_tips: 📌 Always define Primary Key with two mandatory rules: 1) Must be UNIQUE, 2) Cannot be NULL (empty).
📌 Memorize basic SQL syntax: `SELECT [columns] FROM [table] WHERE [condition] ORDER BY [column];`.
📌 Know the difference between DDL (Data Definition Language - CREATE, ALTER, DROP) and DML (Data Manipulation Language - INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).
quick_recap: ⭐ A table column represents a 'Field' (attribute), while a horizontal row represents a 'Record' (tuple).
⭐ Referential integrity prevents you from deleting a record in a parent table if related records exist in a child table.
⭐ Reports are read-only documents designed for printing and professional presentations.
